map.LLM Token 成本估算器，输入输入输出 token 数与单价估算 API: An LLM token cost estimator that takes input and output token counts with unit prices to estimate API charges and converts them to CNY at 1 USD ≈ 7.2 CNY, supporting call budgeting.
map.输入费用 = 输入 tokens / 10⁶ × 输入单价；输出费用 = 输出: Input cost = input tokens / 10⁶ × input price; output cost = output tokens / 10⁶ × output price; CNY ≈ USD × exchange rate
map.大模型 API 普遍按输入与输出分别计价，且输出单价通常高于输入，因此压缩提示词: Large-model APIs generally price input and output separately, and output usually costs more per token, so compressing prompts and limiting generation length directly saves money. Use the exchange rate of the period when converting to CNY, and also consider batch and cache discounts as well as the minimum billing granularity.
map.费用=输入 token×输入单价+输出 token×输出单价，按模型计费口径估算: Cost = input tokens × input price + output tokens × output price, estimated with the model's billing convention.
map.支持按 1 USD≈7.2 CNY 折算人民币，辅助调用预算与成本对比。: Converts to CNY at 1 USD ≈ 7.2 CNY, supporting call budgeting and cost comparison.
map.不同模型分词器差异大，token 数需以对应模型为准，本估算为量级参考。: Tokenizers differ a lot between models, so token counts must come from the matching model; this estimate is an order-of-magnitude reference.
map.：输入 10k token($0.01/1k)、输出 2k token($0.0: For 10k input tokens at $0.01/1k and 2k output tokens at $0.03/1k, the cost is 10×0.01+2×0.03 = 0.16 USD, about 1.15 CNY. Use this to forecast the bill before a batch call.
map.为什么不同模型费用差很多？: Why do the costs differ so much between models?
map.单价随模型能力与上下文长度差异大，且输入输出单价常不同；大上下文/强模型更贵，选: Prices vary widely with model capability and context length, and input and output prices often differ. Large-context or stronger models cost more, so choose with both quality and cost in mind.
map.估算的 token 数准吗？: Is the token count estimate accurate?
